NAME: Tuto
LINE: Welcome to the village of Lumen! It is so good to finally meet you.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Long ago the great lantern on the hill kept every night bright and warm.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: But one winter the lantern went dark and nobody knows why.

NAME: Rial
LINE: Some say it ran out of oil. I say someone forgot to pay the bill.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Rial! This is a serious story!

NAME: Rial
LINE: I am being very serious. Bills are serious business.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: Since that night the forest has grown darker and the paths keep changing.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: And now the lantern has started flickering again all on its own!

NAME: Rial
LINE: Which means someone has to climb up there and take a look.

NAME: Tuto
LINE: That someone is you! Let us get going before the sun sets.
